intro: Section 23.5 covers dialectical behavior therapy (DBT): Linehan's origins and assumptions, the problem-behavior loop it targets (Figure 23-1), its five functions and four modes (skills group, individual therapy, telephone consultation and consultation team, Table 23-7), and results. A dashed box adds the 2024 APA guideline for borderline personality disorder.
objectives: Describe the origins, assumptions and aims of DBT and the patients it was built for.
Explain the problem-behavior loop and where DBT intervenes (Figure 23-1).
List the five functions and four modes of DBT and what happens in each.
State the consultation team agreements and the treatment hierarchy (Table 23-7).
Summarize the results of DBT and its spread to other disorders.
